title: The Four Color Theorem meets Shapes of Polyhedra
summary: We consider solutions to the $4$-color problem for the vertices of sphere triangulations with degree sequence $6,...,6,4,4,4,4,4,4$. We sort these solutions into combinatorial types and show that each generic type $τ$ is parametrized by the set of integer lattice points inside a rational polyhedral convex cone ${\cal C\/}_τ$ of dimension at least 4. There is an integral quadratic form $Q_τ$ on ${\cal C\/}_τ$ whose diagonal part, evaluated on a lattice point, is $3$ times the number of triangles in the corresponding triangulation.
